description: Micro-tune the integrated n2048 active-rank reflector pull without disturbing any other size: bracket active-only synchronization placement, scalar versus aligned vector copies, reflector replication cutoff near tail size 128, and overlap of remote local-v fill with projection setup; preserve rank-ownership correctness, the 608-thread bound, GPU-wide compact [W,V,W] updates, all integrated n512/n1024 behavior, certificates, fallbacks and CUDA guards, and require exact repeats plus n2048 profiling for any sub-percent selection.

Moved the n2048 block barrier and rank_v switch inside the uniform active-remote predicate. Rank 0 and tail-idle CTAs skip the barrier, so rank-0 projection setup can overlap remote local-v fills; active consumers still synchronize before reading their copies. Build and kernelguard passed; validation 39/39. Full metric 30532.676952 us; n2048 84126.953 us, versus parent exact range 30519.596-30547.315 us and n2048 83997.653-84074.186 us.

Restored the parent block synchronization placement and replaced only active remote scalar reflector pulls with aligned float4 loads/stores plus scalar tail cleanup. Build and kernelguard passed; validation 39/39. Full metric 30539.660121 us; n2048 84205.750 us, versus parent scalar n2048 exact range 83997.653-84074.186 us and active-only scalar 84126.953 us.

Changed the active remote reflector copy from float4 to aligned float2 with scalar tail cleanup, retaining parent synchronization and rank ownership. Build and kernelguard passed; validation 39/39. Full metric 30562.132217 us; n2048 84249.530 us, versus float4 30539.660 us / 84205.750 us and parent scalar n2048 83997.653-84074.186 us.

Restored scalar active-rank copies and lowered the n2048 rank-local replication cutoff from size 128 to 96, extending shared-local pulls into three more 11-column tail groups while preserving the row-group ownership predicate. Build and kernelguard passed; validation 39/39. Full metric 30587.019485 us; n2048 84076.795 us. The target is adjacent to the parent 128-cutoff range 83997.653-84074.186 us; unrelated n176/n352/n512/LAPACK variance lifted the aggregate.

Raised the scalar n2048 rank-local replication cutoff from size 96 to 160, so the last tail groups read rank-0 DSM directly while all larger panels retain active-rank copies. Build and kernelguard passed; validation 39/39. Full metric 30538.275229 us; n2048 84051.369 us, versus cutoff 96 at 84076.795 us and parent cutoff 128 exact range 83997.653-84074.186 us.

Restored cutoff 128 and deferred remote local-v synchronization to overlap fills with rank-0 projection: panel columns 1-10 rely on the existing following cluster.sync to publish copies, while panel column 0 retains an active-remote __syncthreads before A*v. Build and kernelguard passed; validation 39/39. Full metric 30538.918260 us; n2048 84123.868 us, versus parent 83997.653-84074.186 us and immediate active-only synchronization 84126.953 us.

Exact-source repeat of cutoff-160 scalar pulls, byte-identical to trial 8da63781e611711b40f7aced3a685d2407f10139 after clean rebuild and 39/39 validation. Full metric 30535.280644 us; n2048 84025.754 us. The two cutoff-160 runs span 30535.281-30538.275 us and 84025.754-84051.369 us; its profile reducer was 116.218584 ms versus the cutoff-128 parent 116.229639 ms.

Selected clean SHA 2db97b813d89cc9f5646ef3fed740291601bbb29, which differs from parent 95b768e531399a059813e14d019621a3cb59b58a only by raising the n2048 scalar reflector-replication cutoff from 128 to 160; rank ownership, 608-thread launch bound, GPU-wide compact updates, all smaller routes, certificates, fallbacks and guards are unchanged. Build and kernelguard passed; validation 39/39. The cutoff-160 source measured 30538.275229 us / n2048 84051.369 us and repeated at 30535.280644 us / 84025.754 us. Parent cutoff-128 exact runs span 30519.596267-30547.314870 us and n2048 83997.653-84074.186 us. Final exact-SHA n2048 Nsys reducer time is 116.204822 ms over 372 launches; the first identical cutoff-160 capture was 116.218584 ms and parent cutoff 128 was 116.229639 ms. Other measured variants: active-only immediate barriers 30532.676952 / 84126.953 us; float4 copies 30539.660121 / 84205.750 us; float2 copies 30562.132217 / 84249.530 us; cutoff 96 scalar copies 30587.019485 / 84076.795 us; projection-overlapped deferred synchronization 30538.918260 / 84123.868 us. No leaderboard submission was made. Concrete follow-ups include testing the natural 152/153 row-group boundary and a 192 upper bracket, making the cutoff depend on active-rank reuse per panel column, varying the number of copy-participating warps while retaining scalar transactions, and striping copy/A*v accumulation behind named barriers instead of waiting for the full reflector.
